kind: Exact authored observation bindings, DATA ONLY; future strict audit/executable validation not prepared or released

sourceService.probesOutsideDirectCallCount: one initial owner context probe each and two owner-release probes in S03; no mutation or wire
sourceService.unknownCleanup: close failure retains directory; primary and cleanup failures aggregated

sourceSelector.failureReportLimit: S04/S05 console observation is reached only after assertions; a failed callback may have no observation, never positive credit

sourceWire.partial: received can precede settlement at actual node response callback; partial text retained on data; received=false leaves status/headers/text null; final report after cleanup snapshots actual rows; failed/unknown never positive

stateMachine.executorReturn: settled=true/received=true, actual response copied before every assertion; writeState may null on bad returned evidence
stateMachine.assertionsComplete: all row.validated=true only after whole work callback and count assertion; subsequent deadline/cleanup failure still outcome failed
stateMachine.completedResponses: number of actual returned settled responses without exchange rejection, independent of validation; never expected count substituted

installed.secrecy: No credential/token/header or authentication digest emitted by new cohorts; runtime identity is observed metadata, not independently regenerated authentication proof. IPC configuration and credential binding are source-attested. Actual raw response wire/body may contain only fixture/public response data; child stdout/stderr bytes not retained.
installed.parentProcessLimitation: Child object only available after launcher ready; startup failure without returned handle remains unknown. Full external parent/descendant absence and actual archive/consumer proof belong to later independent validation, not fabricated here.

bounds: New installed exact executor retains existing 16KiB request headers/64KiB request body/128KiB response body and existing response-header/default wire derivation; no maxWire option or cap widening
positiveRequires: Fresh exact source/package/install/consumer/proof and independent strict observation validation later, not only callback status/count. Full wire matches actual returned status/headers/body; all runtime fit UNKNOWN now.
